Blessing of Fylgjur.effect:
Removes stress equal to the caster's power rating from all allies within Close range; any defeated allies within range immediately recover from defeat, keeping any injuries already suffered.

Flawed: affects all creatures within Close range, not only allies.
Blessing of Fylgjur.momentum:
For 2 Momentum, all affected allies remove a single physical or mental injury each.

For 2 Momentum, the spell affects allies within Medium range instead.

Bounty of Baldr.duration: A number of rounds equal to the spellcaster's power rating
Bounty of Baldr.effect: For the duration, attacks against the caster or any ally within Close range have their difficulty increased by 2.
Bounty of Baldr.momentum: All affected characters gain +X Cover resistance, where X is the amount of Momentum spent.

Curse of Loki.effect:
Inflicts power+2 mental damage with the Stun effect on all enemies within Close range.

Flawed: affects all creatures within range, not only enemies.
Curse of Loki.momentum:
For 2 Momentum, add the Persistent 6 damage effect to the damage.

For 2 Momentum, add the Snare damage effect to the damage.

Hammer of Thunraz.effect: Targets one enemy or object within Medium range, inflicting power+2 physical damage with the Area effect.
Hammer of Thunraz.momentum:
For 1 Momentum, replace the Area damage effect with the Piercing 2 damage effect.

For 2 Momentum, add the Vicious damage effect.

For 2 Momentum, add the Stun damage effect.

Ravens of Wodan.duration: A number of rounds equal to the spellcaster's power rating
Ravens of Wodan.effect: For the duration, the caster and all allies within Close range gain bonus Morale resistance equal to the caster's power rating.
Ravens of Wodan.momentum:
For 2 Momentum, each affected allied target inflicts +2 damage on all melee attacks they make.

For 3 Momentum each, the spellcaster may give one or more affected allies 1 additional nonrefreshing Fortune point each, which is lost at the end of the spell's duration if it has not been used.

Swiftness of Sleipnir.effect: The caster and any allies within Close range may immediately move up to 2 zones. Before the caster's next turn, any affected ally may use Keep the Initiative at no Momentum cost.
Swiftness of Sleipnir.momentum: For 2 Momentum, each affected character may take an additional minor action for free on their next turn.

Wisdom of Frigg.effect: Targets one creature within Medium range. The caster gains +3 bonus Momentum, spendable only to Obtain Information about that creature or to Create a Truth reflecting a known weakness of it.
Wisdom of Frigg.momentum:
For 2 Momentum, if the creature has the Invulnerable special rule, it loses that rule for a number of rounds equal to the spellcaster's power rating.

For 2 Momentum, until the end of the scene, any attacks the spellcaster or their allies make against the targeted creature gain either the Intense or the Vicious damage effect (spellcaster's choice).

Augury.effect:
After a ten-minute casting, the GM secretly determines the result:

Auspicious: once during the spell's duration, the caster may re-roll any number of dice on a single skill test; the spell then ends.

Inauspicious: once during the spell's duration, when the GM spends Threat to Create a Truth (including via Change of Circumstance), the caster may ignore that truth's effects; the spell then ends.
Augury.momentum:
For 2 Momentum, the duration increases by twenty-four hours.

For 2 Momentum, the spellcaster, not the GM, determines the choice of auspices.

Guiding Hand.effect: Choose an ally within Close range. For the duration, whenever that ally spends a Fortune point, roll 1 Challenge Die; on an effect, the spent point is immediately refunded (capped at 1 Fortune refunded regardless of how many effects are rolled).
Guiding Hand.momentum:
For 2 Momentum, increase the duration by twenty-four hours.

For 2 Momentum, the ally's player rolls 2 Challenge Dice instead of 1.

Invoke the Parcae.effect:
As a reaction to any skill test within Close range (ally or enemy), choose one effect:

Critical Success: change one d20 result on that test to 1 (two automatic successes).

Complication: change one d20 result on that test to 20 (generates a complication).

Re-Roll: force all dice on that test to be re-rolled before resolving it.

The target then gains the scar The Fates Must Be Balanced (complication range of their tests +1) until the caster rolls a complication on a skill test, which removes it.
Invoke the Parcae.momentum:
For 2 Momentum, choose two of this spell's spell effects when you invoke the Parcae.

For 2 Momentum, you can invoke the Parcae as a reaction to skill tests performed within Medium range.

For 3 Momentum, you can invoke the Parcae for tests performed within Long range.

Prescience.effect: For the duration, the caster holds the truth Vision of the Future, usable at any point within that time. The spell ends once that truth benefits a single skill test.
Prescience.momentum:
For 2 Momentum, the spell does not end when the oracle benefits from the Vision of the Future truth.

For 2 Momentum, the oracle receives a vision of another character's future and can give the Vision of the Future truth to that character instead.

Scrying.duration: A number of rounds equal to the oracle's power rating
Scrying.effect: Select a known object or location within Close range to study, including hidden or obscured parts of it (sealed, locked, or enclosed). May switch focus to another target within range up to once per round for the duration. Momentum spent to Obtain Information while active can reveal things not normally visible.
Scrying.momentum:
Unlike the costs of most spells, Scrying's cost increases by +1 Challenge Die for each Momentum spent on either of the following options:

For 1 Momentum, the oracle may select an object within Medium range. For 2 Momentum, they may select an object within Long range. For 3 Momentum, they may select an object in any location they are familiar with on Earth. In all cases, the oracle must be aware of the object or location before using this spell.

For 3 Momentum, the oracle may instead choose an object within Reach and gain limited knowledge about that object's past. Additional Momentum spent to Obtain Information may be used to ask questions about the object's history, whether recent or distant. The GM's answers to these questions may be cryptic, and some past events may be unpleasant or even dangerous to see. The range of the spell may not be increased if this option is used.

Second Sight.effect: Targets the caster or one ally within Close range. For the duration, the target reduces the difficulty of vision-based tests by 2, ignores darkness-caused difficulty/complication increases, can attempt tests otherwise impossible due to darkness, and gains the See the Unseen truth.
Second Sight.momentum: For 1 to 5 Momentum, choose one additional allied character to be targeted by the spell for each Momentum spent.

Bounties of the Dagda.effect: All allies within Close range immediately remove stress equal to the caster's power rating.
Bounties of the Dagda.momentum:
For 1 Momentum, all defeated allies within range return from defeat immediately.

For 2 Momentum, all affected allies remove a single injury (physical or mental).

For 2 Momentum, the spell affects allies within Medium range instead.

Cyclone of Cernunnos.duration: A number of rounds equal to the spellcaster's power rating
Cyclone of Cernunnos.effect:
Summons a cyclone into a zone within Medium range; it acts on its own turn in the action order and cannot be attacked or damaged. On cast, and at the start of each of its turns, it inflicts power+1 physical damage (Piercing 1, Stun; also Vicious against supernatural creatures) on all creatures and damageable objects within Close range of it, then moves to an adjacent zone. The caster chooses its direction while within Medium range of it; beyond that range it holds position unless the GM spends 1 Threat to move it.

Flawed: the caster cannot direct the cyclone, and the GM may move it without spending Threat.
Cyclone of Cernunnos.momentum: The spellcaster may increase the damage the cyclone inflicts by +1 per Momentum spent.

Gaze of Balor.effect: Targets one enemy within Medium range, inflicting power+2 mental damage with the Intense effect.
Gaze of Balor.momentum:
For 2 Momentum, add the Drain damage effect.

For 2 Momentum, add the Persistent 6 damage effect.

Gift of Arduinna.duration: A total number of rounds equal to the spellcaster's power rating, divided evenly among the affected targets (rounding down all fractions)
Gift of Arduinna.effect: Affects the caster and allies within Close range, up to a number of targets equal to the caster's power rating. For the duration, affected targets gain +1 zone of movement whenever they move (minor or major action), may take one additional free minor action each turn, and move through wooded terrain, broken ground, and streams without hindrance.
Gift of Arduinna.momentum: For every 2 Momentum spent, the spellcaster or a single affected ally may take an additional major action during one of their own turns, provided the turn takes place before the spell's duration ends. No character may gain more than one additional major action this way.

Horn of Néit.duration: A number of rounds equal to the spellcaster's power rating
Horn of Néit.effect: Targets all enemies within Medium range. Roll Challenge Dice equal to the caster's power rating; compare the number of effects to each target's Athletics ranks (add scale for larger-than-human targets). Any target with fewer Athletics ranks than effects rolled suffers Snare and can only act to break free, requiring an Agility+Athletics or Brawn+Athletics test at a difficulty equal to the effects rolled. Ensnared targets are freed automatically when the spell ends.
Horn of Néit.momentum:
For each Momentum spent, one additional creature within Long range is also affected.

For each Momentum spent, the spellcaster rolls +1 Challenge Die.

The Ogham Sign.effect: Targets one supernatural creature within Medium range, inflicting power+2 mental damage with Drain and Piercing 2, even against creatures normally immune to mental attacks (treat their Courage as 6 for this purpose). A target that suffers a mental injury from this spell loses Invulnerable for the rest of the scene. A target defeated by this spell is banished to its realm of origin.
The Ogham Sign.momentum:
For 2 Momentum, add the Intense damage effect.

For 2 Momentum, add the Stun damage effect.

Roots of the Earth.effect: Affects the caster and allies within Close range, up to a number of targets equal to half the caster's power rating (round up). Affected characters teleport instantly to any point within Long range that they have line of sight to.
Roots of the Earth.momentum: For 2 Momentum, all creatures transported by the spell receive +2 Cover resistance until the start of the spellcaster's next turn.

Spear of Lug.effect: Targets one enemy or object within Medium range, inflicting power+2 physical damage with Piercing 3.
Spear of Lug.momentum:
For 2 Momentum, add the Intense damage effect.

For 2 Momentum, add the Vicious damage effect.

Call of the Deep.duration: Until the end of the current scene
Call of the Deep.effect:
Targets a single living creature within Medium range. If affected, it moves towards the nearest large body of water it can see (GM's discretion whether it is large enough). Its only actions are moving towards that water and trying to break free (Will + Resilience, difficulty 2). On reaching the water it enters and dives downwards until it breaks free or drowns. If it cannot see a body of water it acts normally, but the spell stays in effect until it breaks free.

Each Effect rolled on the cost adds 1 to Threat.
Call of the Deep.momentum:
For 2 Momentum, the difficulty of any test to break free increases by +1 (not repeatable).

For 2 Momentum, the target moves towards the nearest large body of water whether or not it can see it.

Curse of Cthulhu.effect:
All enemies within Close range suffer power+1 mental stress with the Piercing 1 and Stun effects.

Flawed: affects all creatures within range, not just enemies.
Curse of Cthulhu.momentum: For 2 Momentum, add the Persistent 4 effect to the damage; the persistent damage also has the Stun effect.

Echo of the Ocean.duration: A number of rounds equal to the spellcaster's power
Echo of the Ocean.effect: The spellcaster and all allies within Close range inflict +1 stress on all their attacks (melee, ranged and mental) and gain +2 Morale.

Gift of Cthulhu.difficulty: 2; if the target is unwilling, opposed by its Will + Resilience (difficulty 2)
Gift of Cthulhu.duration: A number of days equal to the spellcaster's power, or earlier if the spellcaster ends it
Gift of Cthulhu.effect: Targets the spellcaster or a single human within Reach. The target gains the truth Deep One Transmutation (breathes and moves easily underwater, peculiar appearance), an Athletics focus in Swimming, and the Nauseating ability (see Deep One Hybrid). When the effects end, unwilling targets roll to see if they develop a scar, as if recovering from a mental injury.
Gift of Cthulhu.momentum:
If cast on an unwilling victim, for 2 Momentum the target also suffers 4 Piercing 2 mental damage.

If cast on the spellcaster or a willing target, for 2 Momentum they may suppress the transmutation for up to an hour at a time without ending the effect.

Pool of Limpid Bliss.duration: Until the end of the current scene
Pool of Limpid Bliss.effect: Choose a zone within Medium range: an alluring pool appears there. Enemies in that zone at the start of their turn must pass a Will + Resilience test (difficulty 2) or suffer 4 mental stress with the Stun effect and move into the pool (even if stunned). A character defeated by mental stress from the pool submerges and begins Dying as they drown.
Pool of Limpid Bliss.momentum:
For 2 Momentum, increase the difficulty of all tests to resist the spell by 1.

For 1 Momentum each, increase the spell's damage by +1.

For 2 Momentum, add the Piercing 1 effect.

Swimmer in the Elder Current.effect: Affects the spellcaster and allies within Close range, up to half the spellcaster's power (rounding up) in targets. They turn to water and reappear moments later anywhere within sight within Long range. Characters moved this way cannot act on their following turn, as if Stunned.
Swimmer in the Elder Current.momentum:
For 2 Momentum, all transported characters gain +2 cover until the start of the spellcaster's next turn.

For 2 Momentum, all transported characters other than the spellcaster recover stress equal to the spellcaster's Survival skill.

Wave Storm.duration: A number of rounds equal to the spellcaster's power
Wave Storm.effect:
Conjures a vortex of water in a zone within Medium range. It takes its own turn and cannot be attacked or damaged. At the start of its turn it inflicts physical stress equal to the spellcaster's power+1, with the Piercing 1 and Snare effects, on all creatures and damageable objects within Close range, then moves to an adjacent zone carrying anything it ensnared. The spellcaster chooses its direction while within Medium range of it; otherwise it stays put, or the GM may spend 1 Threat to move it.

Flawed: the spellcaster cannot control the vortex, and the GM need not spend Threat to move it.
Wave Storm.momentum: The spellcaster may increase the vortex's damage by +1 per Momentum spent.

Acidic Transformation.effect:
The spellcaster's flesh becomes corrosive. Their unarmed attacks inflict +Power physical damage with the Persistent 4 and Piercing 1 effects. Enemies who make melee attacks against or grapple the spellcaster with natural weapons or unarmed attacks suffer 3 physical stress with the Piercing 1 effect.

Flawed: the spellcaster's body corrodes too: they suffer 3 physical stress with the Drain effect at the end of every turn while the spell lasts.
Acidic Transformation.momentum: For 1 Momentum, damage inflicted by this spell's effect gains the Vicious effect.

Black Goat's Blessing.duration: Until the end of the current scene
Black Goat's Blessing.effect:
Choose a number of allies within Close range equal to your Power: their Armor resistance increases by +2 and they regenerate 2 stress at the end of each turn.

Flawed: recipients mutate grotesquely, increasing their Complication range by +1.
Black Goat's Blessing.momentum:
For 2 Momentum, increase the stress regeneration by an additional 2.

For 1+ Momentum, affect one additional ally per Momentum spent.

Call the Corpse Eaters.difficulty: 1 plus the number of ghoul mobs
Call the Corpse Eaters.duration: Until the end of the current scene
Call the Corpse Eaters.effect:
Summons one, two or three ghouls (see Ghoul) to aid the spellcaster; several act as a mob. They obey the spellcaster's commands, though demanding orders may need more persuasion, and return to their realm when the spell ends.

Flawed: the ghouls are summoned but not under the spellcaster's control.
Call the Corpse Eaters.momentum: For 1+ Momentum, summon one additional ghoul per Momentum spent.

Foul Birthing.duration: Until the end of the current scene
Foul Birthing.effect:
Infuses a single allied NPC with a latent transformation that triggers on their defeat, spawning an insect swarm or a rat swarm. The creatures disperse when the spell ends.

Flawed: it may trigger prematurely; the GM may spend 2 Threat to make it trigger whenever they wish.
Foul Birthing.momentum: For 1 Momentum (paid when cast), the spawned creatures are under the spellcaster's control.

Necrophagus.effect:
Targets a single enemy within Medium range, inflicting physical stress equal to the spellcaster's Power+2. The spellcaster or an ally within Close range recovers up to half the stress inflicted.

Flawed: neither the spellcaster nor an ally recovers stress.
Necrophagus.momentum: For 1 Momentum, the spell gains the Vicious effect.

Sacrificial Rebirth.duration: Until the end of the current scene
Sacrificial Rebirth.effect:
Sacrifices a creature within Reach (willing or completely immobile, no larger than Scale 0, and a Trooper NPC; slain instantly) to summon a Foetid Young of Mormo that obeys the spellcaster until the end of the scene, then vanishes.

Flawed: the Foetid Young is summoned but not under the spellcaster's control.
Sacrificial Rebirth.momentum: For 2 Momentum, the Foetid Young is summoned with an additional +1 Brawn and Resilience.

Whisper of the Woods.duration: Until the end of the current scene
Whisper of the Woods.effect:
Plant life grows rapidly to ensnare enemies. Select a single zone within Long range: enemies there must pass an Athletics test (difficulty 2) or become restrained, unable to move until they pass an Athletics test on their turn.

Flawed: the plants grow out of control, affecting every creature in the area, not only enemies.
Whisper of the Woods.momentum: For 2 Momentum, affect one additional zone within range; usable up to a number of times equal to the spellcaster's Power.

Delirium of the Dark Pharaoh.effect:
Targets a single creature within Medium range: it suffers power rating+1 mental stress with the Persistent 5 effect. If this (or the Persistent damage) would inflict one or more injuries, the target instead flies into a violent frenzy, attacking the nearest creature, friend or foe, until the end of the scene or until Defeated.

Each Effect rolled on the cost adds 1 to Threat.
Delirium of the Dark Pharaoh.momentum:
For 2 Momentum, the initial damage and the Persistent rolls gain the Piercing 1 effect.

For every 2 Momentum, affect one additional target.

Lesser Black Rain.duration: A number of rounds equal to the spellcaster's power rating
Lesser Black Rain.effect: A storm gathers above a zone the spellcaster can perceive within Long range. It cannot be attacked or damaged and takes its own turn. It does nothing on its first turn; on each later turn it inflicts power rating+1 physical damage with the Piercing 1 effect on all creatures and damageable objects in its zone that are not within hard cover.
Lesser Black Rain.momentum:
For 2 Momentum, add the Vicious effect.

For 2 Momentum, move the storm to an adjacent zone as a major action (Will + Resilience, difficulty 2).

Mask of the Faceless Sphinx.duration: A number of rounds equal to the spellcaster's power rating
Mask of the Faceless Sphinx.effect: The spellcaster and all allies within Close range become harder to hit: attacks against them are +1 difficulty, and they count as having heavy cover.
Mask of the Faceless Sphinx.momentum:
For 2 Momentum, the difficulty increase becomes +2.

For 2 Momentum, affected characters gain +4 Cover resistance instead of heavy cover's +2.

For 3 Momentum, any ranged or melee attack that misses an affected character inflicts 4 mental damage with the Stun effect on the attacker.

Rays of the Black Sun.effect: Also called Lesser Dread Equinox. Targets a single enemy within Medium range: power rating+2 mental damage with the Piercing 1 and Snare effects.
Rays of the Black Sun.momentum:
For 2 Momentum, the spell gains the Persistent 4 effect.

For every 2 Momentum, affect one additional target.

The Nameless Mists.duration: A number of rounds equal to the spellcaster's power
The Nameless Mists.effect:
A foul mist fills the spellcaster's zone. Any enemy in it at the end of their turn suffers mental damage equal to the spellcaster's power rating+1, with the Piercing 2 and Stun effects. The zone gains the truth Shifting, Vile Mists, hindering vision for the spellcaster's enemies only.

Each Effect rolled on the cost adds 1 to Threat.

Flawed: it affects all creatures, not just enemies.
The Nameless Mists.momentum:
For 2 Momentum, the spell also gains the Drain effect.

Extend the mist into adjacent zones for 2 Momentum per additional zone.

The Shape of Hate.duration: A number of rounds equal to the spellcaster's power rating
The Shape of Hate.effect:
Affects a number of allies within Close range equal to the spellcaster's power rating (may include or exclude the spellcaster). When first cast, they immediately make a minor action to move toward the nearest enemy. Affected allies inflict +2 damage on all melee attacks.

[Check against the book, p.164: the PDF text for this spell and the two after it was jumbled across columns.]
The Shape of Hate.momentum:
For 2 Momentum, the spell gains the Intense damage effect.

For 2 Momentum, when an affected ally makes a successful melee attack, they may make a second melee attack at +1 difficulty.

Binding of Yog-Sothoth.effect:
All enemies within Close range suffer power+2 mental stress with the Snare effect. Enemies who would suffer one or more injuries are paralyzed instead; a paralyzed enemy can only try to break free (Will + Resilience, difficulty 3).

[Check against the book, p.165: Momentum options were not clearly attributable in the PDF text.]

Touch of the Black Sun.effect:
Targets an enemy within Close range with a torrent of black flame, inflicting power rating+2 physical damage with the Area and Persistent 4 effects. The spellcaster cannot affect themselves with this spell.

[Check against the book, p.165: the PDF text was jumbled across columns.]

Flawed: it affects all creatures within Close range, not just enemies.
Touch of the Black Sun.momentum:
For 2 Momentum, the spell gains the Piercing 1 effect.

For 2 Momentum, the spell gains the Persistent 3 effect; the Persistent damage also has the Snare effect.

Foetid Touch of Aforgomon.difficulty: 3, opposed by the target's Agility + Fighting (difficulty 3)
Foetid Touch of Aforgomon.effect:
Targets a single enemy within Reach: power+1 physical stress with the Persistent 3 effect. A character Defeated by this spell starts dying; if they die, a Bloodborn emerges from their remains the following round.

Each Effect rolled on the cost adds 1 to Threat.
Foetid Touch of Aforgomon.momentum:
For 2 Momentum, gain Piercing 2 on both the initial and the Persistent stress.

For 2 Momentum, gain Intense on both the initial and the Persistent stress.

Gaze of the Multiverse.effect:
All enemies within Close range suffer power+2 mental stress with the Stun effect.

Flawed: it affects all creatures within Close range, not just enemies.
Gaze of the Multiverse.momentum:
For 2 Momentum, the spell gains the Drain effect.

For 2 Momentum, the spell gains the Vicious effect.

Loathsome Bond of 'Umr at-Tawil.effect:
Each enemy within Close range suffers power+1 mental stress with the Drain and Piercing 1 effects. If the spell inflicts one or more injuries, the spellcaster may remove one of their own injuries.

Each Effect rolled on the cost adds 1 to Threat.

Flawed: it targets every creature within Close range, not just enemies.
Loathsome Bond of 'Umr at-Tawil.momentum:
For 2 Momentum, the spell gains the Piercing 2 effect.

For 2 Momentum, the spell gains the Intense effect.

For 2 Momentum, the spellcaster removes one injury for each injury inflicted.

Way of the Gatekeeper.effect: Transports a number of willing allies within Close range equal to half the spellcaster's power (rounding up), optionally including themselves; they vanish and reappear in any zone within Long range.
Way of the Gatekeeper.momentum:
For 2 Momentum, the maximum number of allies equals the spellcaster's power instead of half.

For 2 Momentum, they may reappear at a familiar location within a mile (somewhere the spellcaster has spent at least an hour).

Spheres of Yog-Sothoth.difficulty: Equal to the number of spheres (1-3)
Spheres of Yog-Sothoth.effect:
Conjures one, two or three spheres hurled at different enemies within Medium range; the difficulty equals the number of spheres. Each enemy hit suffers power+2 physical stress with the Drain and Stun effects.

Each Effect rolled on the cost adds 1 to Threat.
Spheres of Yog-Sothoth.momentum: For 2 Momentum, the spell gains the Piercing 2 effect.
